integrity: Every reported maximum set and the sharp finite upper bound are established by transparent exhaustive bitset-clique search, supplemented by an explicit construction and full automorphism-orbit check. Source code and captured output provided; no randomized or timeout-based conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact enumeration of the five-cube only; no formula for other dimensions. Potential unindexed equivalent results under induced-star packing/injective edge coloring remain a literature risk. No independent audit.
title: The five-cube has exactly eighty maximum edge-open packings
